Now I have the model predictions:
- Median prediction mean: 0.9729 (very high, meaning far from tipping point)
- First third mean: 0.9695
- Last third mean: 0.9873 (even higher, meaning moving away from tipping point)
- Last window: 0.9896 (very far from tipping point)
- p_critical mean: 0.0402 (low probability of being near tipping)
- p_critical last window: 0.0337
- p_critical last third mean: 0.0317
- Share of windows above half: 0.0 (no windows have p_critical > 0.5)

The prediction is close to 1 (far from tipping point) and increasing over time. The p_critical is very low. This strongly suggests "no_alert".

The system is far from a tipping point and the trend is moving further away (prediction increasing from 0.9695 to 0.9873 to 0.9896).

Decision: no_alert
Confidence: high, maybe 0.9 or higher
Rationale: The model predicts values near 1 (far from tipping) throughout, with the last third and last window even higher (~0.988-0.990). p_critical is very low (~0.03-0.04) and no windows exceed 0.5. The series shows no approach to the tipping point.
